title: Evaluating Molecular Docking Software for Small Molecule Binding to G-Quadruplex DNA.
authors: Dickerhoff, Jonathan; Warnecke, Kassandra R; Wang, Kaibo; Deng, Nanjie; Yang, Danzhou
one_liner_zh: 该文系统评估四种分子对接软件预测小分子与G-四链体DNA结合模式的能力，属于蛋白质-DNA互作（核酸-配体）的对接方法评估，虽非TF-DNA体系，但对接与打分方法可迁移至TF-DNA复合物建模，具有方法学参考价值。
abstract: G-quadruplexes are four-stranded nucleic acid secondary structures of biological significance and have emerged as an attractive drug target. The G4 formed in the MYC promoter (MycG4) is one of the most studied small-molecule targets, and a model system for parallel structures that are prevalent in promoter DNA G4s and RNA G4s. Molecular docking has become an essential tool in structure-based drug discovery for protein targets, and is also increasingly applied to G4 DNA. However, DNA, and in particular G4, binding sites differ significantly from protein targets. Here we perform the first systematic evaluation of four commonly used docking programs (AutoDock Vina, DOCK 6, Glide, and RxDock) for G4 DNA-ligand binding pose prediction using four small molecules whose complex structures with the MycG4 have been experimentally determined in solution. The results indicate that there are considerable differences in the performance of the docking programs and that DOCK 6 with GB/SA rescoring performs better than the other programs. We found that docking accuracy is mainly limited by the scoring functions. The study shows that current docking programs should be used with caution to predict G4 DNA-small molecule binding modes.
abstract_zh: G-四链体（G-quadruplexes）是四链核酸二级结构，具有生物学意义，并已成为一个有吸引力的药物靶点。在MYC启动子中形成的G4（MycG4）是最常研究的小分子靶点之一，也是启动子DNA G4和RNA G4中普遍存在的平行结构的模型系统。分子对接（molecular docking）已成为基于结构的蛋白质靶点药物发现中的关键工具，并日益应用于G4 DNA。然而，DNA，特别是G4，其结合位点与蛋白质靶点显著不同。在此，我们使用四个小分子，其与MycG4的复合结构已在溶液中通过实验确定，对四种常用对接程序（AutoDock Vina、DOCK 6、Glide和RxDock）在G4 DNA-配体结合姿态预测方面进行了首次系统评估。结果表明，这些对接程序的性能存在显著差异，且DOCK 6结合GB/SA重打分优于其他程序。我们发现，对接准确性主要受限于打分函数。本研究显示，当前对接程序在预测G4 DNA-小分子结合模式时应谨慎使用。
